column1: # Sable application set for the Zinwa Q25.
#   module        Soong module name in vendor/sable/q25
#   group         platform = keyboard-first platform apps (Titan 2 C3B set)
#                 common   = common Sable apps (Panther R9 set)
#   gradle_root   Gradle project, relative to sable-src/, or flavor:NAME for an app
#                 built as a Sable flavor over a pinned upstream (sable-src/apps/r8/NAME)
#   gradle_task   task that produces the APK
#   apk           APK path relative to gradle_root (one glob match required)
#   signing       unsigned  = release APK, signed by the platform build (default dev cert)
#                 presigned = APK already signed (debug-signed engineering APK)
#   overrides     comma-separated modules this app replaces, or -
#   enabled       yes/no: whether scripts/build-apps.sh builds it by default
# Package ids stay as they are in SableOS (for example org.sableos.titan2.keyboard):
# the Q25 does not fork common apps.
